verdict.rationale: The only hint of bulk-scale capability is the free-trial note that users can 'calculate up to 1,000 transactions,' implying AvaTax's API can handle many calculations, but no documented bulk-create/batch API method or MCP tool exists for processing many items in a single call — the MCP tools listed (CreateTransaction, ListTransactions, CreateNexus) are single-item or query operations. Missing for 10: a documented bulk/batch transaction creation endpoint or MCP tool, evidence of parallel/batch processing semantics, and any hands-on confirmation of bulk throughput.
